component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.top.backgroundColor = "0x030712FF" m.top.backgroundURI = ""
' Server config m.serverUrl = "https://mediaview-ads.preview.emergentagent.com" m.pollInterval = 60 m.currentIndex = 0 m.playlist = []
' Create UI createUI()
' Start loading m.timer = createObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.duration = m.pollInterval m.timer.observeField("fire", "onPollTimer")
m.playTimer = createObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.playTimer.repeat = false m.playTimer.observeField("fire", "onPlayNext")
' Register device first registerDevice() end sub
sub createUI() ' Background m.bg = createObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") m.bg.width = 1920 m.bg.height = 1080 m.bg.color = "0x030712FF" m.top.appendChild(m.bg)
' Logo text (fallback) m.logoLabel = createObject("roSGNode", "Label") m.logoLabel.text = "MediAd View" m.logoLabel.font = createObject("roSGNode", "Font") m.logoLabel.font.size = 64 m.logoLabel.color = "0xF1F5F9FF" m.logoLabel.horizAlign = "center" m.logoLabel.vertAlign = "center" m.logoLabel.width = 1920 m.logoLabel.height = 200 m.logoLabel.translation = [0, 350] m.top.appendChild(m.logoLabel)
' Subtitle m.subLabel = createObject("roSGNode", "Label") m.subLabel.text = "Advertising Solution" m.subLabel.font = createObject("roSGNode", "Font") m.subLabel.font.size = 28 m.subLabel.color = "0x818CF8FF" m.subLabel.horizAlign = "center" m.subLabel.width = 1920 m.subLabel.height = 80 m.subLabel.translation = [0, 460] m.top.appendChild(m.subLabel)
' Status text m.statusLabel = createObject("roSGNode", "Label") m.statusLabel.text = "Initializing..." m.statusLabel.font = createObject("roSGNode", "Font") m.statusLabel.font.size = 24 m.statusLabel.color = "0x64748BFF" m.statusLabel.horizAlign = "center" m.statusLabel.width = 1920 m.statusLabel.height = 60 m.statusLabel.translation = [0, 560] m.top.appendChild(m.statusLabel)
' Activation code display m.codeLabel = createObject("roSGNode", "Label") m.codeLabel.text = "" m.codeLabel.font = createObject("roSGNode", "Font") m.codeLabel.font.size = 96 m.codeLabel.color = "0xA5B4FCFF" m.codeLabel.horizAlign = "center" m.codeLabel.width = 1920 m.codeLabel.height = 150 m.codeLabel.translation = [0, 640] m.codeLabel.visible = false m.top.appendChild(m.codeLabel)
' Media poster (for images) m.mediaPoster = createObject("roSGNode", "Poster") m.mediaPoster.width = 1920 m.mediaPoster.height = 1080 m.mediaPoster.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" m.mediaPoster.visible = false m.top.appendChild(m.mediaPoster)
' Video player m.videoPlayer = createObject("roSGNode", "Video") m.videoPlayer.width = 1920 m.videoPlayer.height = 1080 m.videoPlayer.visible = false m.videoPlayer.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.top.appendChild(m.videoPlayer) end sub
sub registerDevice() m.statusLabel.text = "Registering device..."
' Check if already registered sec = createObject("roRegistrySection", "mediadview") m.deviceId = sec.Read("device_id") m.activationCode = sec.Read("activation_code")
if m.deviceId <> "" and m.deviceId <> invalid m.statusLabel.text = "Checking activation..." checkActivation() else ' Register new device doRegister() end if end sub
sub doRegister() url = m.serverUrl + "/api/devices/register" request = createObject("roUrlTransfer") request.setUrl(url) request.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") request.initClientCertificates() request.addHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
body = FormatJson({ device_name: "MediAd View Roku Player", device_model: "Roku/" + createObject("roDeviceInfo").getModel(), os_version: createObject("roDeviceInfo").getVersion(), app_version: "1.0.0", resolution: "1920x1080", platform: "roku" })
response = request.postFromString(body) if response <> invalid and response <> "" json = ParseJson(response) if json <> invalid and json.device_id <> invalid m.deviceId = json.device_id m.activationCode = json.activation_code
' Save to registry sec = createObject("roRegistrySection", "mediadview") sec.Write("device_id", m.deviceId) sec.Write("activation_code", m.activationCode) sec.Flush()
showActivationScreen() else m.statusLabel.text = "Registration failed. Retrying..." sleep(5000) doRegister() end if else m.statusLabel.text = "Cannot connect to server. Retrying..." sleep(5000) doRegister() end if end sub
sub showActivationScreen() m.logoLabel.visible = true m.subLabel.visible = true m.codeLabel.visible = true m.codeLabel.text = m.activationCode m.statusLabel.text = "Enter this code in the MediAd View Admin Panel" m.mediaPoster.visible = false m.videoPlayer.visible = false
' Start polling for activation m.timer.duration = 5 m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub checkActivation() if m.deviceId = "" or m.deviceId = invalid then return
url = m.serverUrl + "/api/devices/" + m.deviceId + "/check" request = createObject("roUrlTransfer") request.setUrl(url) request.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") request.initClientCertificates()
response = request.getToString() if response <> invalid and response <> "" json = ParseJson(response) if json <> invalid and json.status = "active" and json.screen_id <> invalid ' Device is activated! m.screenId = json.screen_id sec = createObject("roRegistrySection", "mediadview") sec.Write("screen_id", m.screenId) sec.Flush()
startPlaying() else ' Not activated yet if m.codeLabel.visible = false showActivationScreen() end if end if end if end sub
sub startPlaying() m.logoLabel.visible = false m.subLabel.visible = false m.codeLabel.visible = false m.statusLabel.text = "Loading content..."
' Switch to content polling m.timer.duration = m.pollInterval m.timer.control = "start"
fetchPlaylist() end sub
sub fetchPlaylist() if m.deviceId = "" or m.deviceId = invalid then return
url = m.serverUrl + "/api/devices/" + m.deviceId + "/playlist" request = createObject("roUrlTransfer") request.setUrl(url) request.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") request.initClientCertificates()
response = request.getToString() if response <> invalid and response <> "" json = ParseJson(response) if json <> invalid and json.items <> invalid m.playlist = json.items if m.playlist.count() > 0 m.statusLabel.visible = false m.currentIndex = 0 playCurrentItem() else showFallback("No campaigns scheduled") end if end if else showFallback("Connection lost - retrying...") end if
' Send heartbeat sendHeartbeat() end sub
sub playCurrentItem() if m.playlist.count() = 0 then return if m.currentIndex >= m.playlist.count() then m.currentIndex = 0
item = m.playlist[m.currentIndex] mediaUrl = m.serverUrl + item.download_url duration = item.duration if duration = invalid then duration = 15
contentType = item.content_type if contentType <> invalid and Left(contentType, 6) = "image/" ' Show image m.mediaPoster.uri = mediaUrl m.mediaPoster.visible = true m.videoPlayer.visible = false
' Schedule next m.playTimer.duration = duration m.playTimer.control = "start" else ' Play video content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = mediaUrl content.streamFormat = "mp4" m.videoPlayer.content = content m.videoPlayer.visible = true m.mediaPoster.visible = false m.videoPlayer.control = "play"
' Fallback timer m.playTimer.duration = duration m.playTimer.control = "start" end if end sub
sub onPlayNext() m.currentIndex = m.currentIndex + 1 if m.currentIndex >= m.playlist.count() then m.currentIndex = 0 playCurrentItem() end sub
sub onVideoState() state = m.videoPlayer.state if state = "finished" or state = "error" onPlayNext() end if end sub
sub onPollTimer() if m.screenId <> invalid and m.screenId <> "" fetchPlaylist() else checkActivation() end if end sub
sub showFallback(msg as string) m.logoLabel.visible = true m.subLabel.visible = true m.statusLabel.visible = true m.statusLabel.text = msg m.codeLabel.visible = false m.mediaPoster.visible = false m.videoPlayer.visible = false end sub
sub sendHeartbeat() if m.deviceId = "" or m.deviceId = invalid then return
url = m.serverUrl + "/api/devices/" + m.deviceId + "/heartbeat" request = createObject("roUrlTransfer") request.setUrl(url) request.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") request.initClientCertificates() request.addHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
body = FormatJson({ status: "online", app_version: "1.0.0" })
request.postFromString(body) end sub
